title: ClinVar variant-condition aggregate track pack (hg38)
context: ClinVar is a US-government public-domain resource aggregating variant-condition associations from clinical laboratories and research submitters. It is covered in the M1 pack task (pack-012); this source-catalog entry records the per-source gate triage. The re-identification check is particularly important here because ClinVar aggregates submissions that could, in edge cases, reference rare variants — the aggregate-data-tier check must confirm that the track is built from aggregate VCF data, not small-cohort extracts.
objective: Apply the licensegate-002 gate (including re-identification check) to ClinVar, produce a committed PASS artifact, and deliver the ClinVar cancer-relevant variants pack on hg38 if not already covered by pack-012.
acceptanceCriteria: Source is ClinVar (NCBI, US-gov public domain); licensegate-002 PASS artifact committed with permitsRedistribution: true.
Re-identification check explicitly run and PASS recorded; aggregate VCF source confirmed (not a small-cohort extract).
coordgate-003 PASS artifact committed for hg38; coordinate convention (VCF 1-based) handled and recorded.
All three browser targets emitted and render-verified; ClinVar features appear at expected cancer-gene loci on hg38 with evidence in outcomes/ds-clinvar-004.json.
Per-feature provenance records ClinVar variation IDs, source release, and public-domain license; provenance completeness ≥ 90/100; not-medical-advice notice present.
output: output/packs/clinvar-cancer-hg38/ — track files, browser configs, gate artifacts, manifest, and outcomes/ds-clinvar-004.json.
